rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that follows logically.

example.english: This reasoning is logical and has no gaps.
example.traditional: 呢個推理合乎邏輯，冇漏洞。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 teoi1 lei5 hap6 fu4 lo4 zap1 mou5 lau6 dung6

rows.note: Use this when “logical” means reasonable or acceptable rather than strictly following formal logic.

example.english: Your way of arranging the time is quite logical.
example.traditional: 你咁樣安排時間都幾合理。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng6 on1 paai4 si4 gaan3 dou1 gei2 hap6 lei5
